summary: Full regression of the Indonesian restructure of Easy Expense. Backend pytest suite (27 tests) 100% pass, including Categories CRUD (add/rename/duplicate=400/delete + rename propagation to expenses), Projects CRUD with aggregates + cascade delete (detaches expenses), Work Orders CRUD (project validation + detach on delete), Expenses CRUD w/ project+work_order+category+search filters (no tax/currency fields present), /api/scan multipart JPEG -> OpenAI gpt-5.4 extraction (vendor/amount/date/category/notes only, no tax/currency), /api/files/{path} serves image, /api/reports/summary week/month/quarter/year (no total_tax field), /api/reports/export CSV with Indonesian headers and integer Rp amounts, /api/projects/{id}/pdf returns application/pdf with %PDF- header. Frontend Playwright smoke on mobile viewport 390x844: Indonesian tabs Beranda/Pengeluaran/Laporan/Proyek + center Scan FAB, Rupiah 'Rp 235.000' formatting, home hero + Kategori Teratas/Proyek Aktif bento, Pengeluaran tab search + horizontal category chips + list, Laporan tab with Minggu/Bulan/Kuartal/Tahun segmented control + Tren + Per Kategori + Ekspor CSV button, Proyek tab lists projects and has 'Kelola Kategori' link, Kategori screen lists 7 categories with rename/delete icons + add (+) button, Add form validation shows 'Masukkan jumlah yang valid', Project detail shows total + WO list + 'Ekspor Laporan PDF', Work Order detail shows 'Scan Struk' + 'Manual' + expenses list, Scan screen mounts with camera permission gate + 'Unggah dari galeri' fallback. Deprecated RN-Web warnings still present (shadow*, pointerEvents) - non-blocking.

react_native_issues.issue: React-Native-Web console warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Migrate shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius to boxShadow. Reference: shadow utilities used across index.tsx, reports.tsx, scan.tsx, projects.tsx, project/[id].tsx, workorder/[id].tsx
React-Native-Web warning: props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents. Reference: /app/frontend/app/scan.tsx (reticle View that uses pointerEvents='none' prop)

action_items: Optional polish: migrate shadow* style props to boxShadow in src/theme.ts (silences RN-Web deprecation warnings)
Optional polish: move pointerEvents='none' from prop to style on scan.tsx reticle View
critical_code_review_comments: server.py cleanly excludes MongoDB _id via Pydantic reconstruction (Expense/Project/WorkOrder/Category models rebuilt from docs). Verified 200 JSON serialization across all endpoints.
Rupiah helper rupiah() uses int(round(...)) and dot-thousands separators - matches spec 'Rp 25.000' with no decimals.
extract_receipt() enforces category to be one of the current DB category names (falls back to first) - good defensive coding.
Project delete cascades work orders and detaches expenses (project_id/work_order_id set to None) - verified in test_delete_project_cascades.
Category rename propagates to expenses via update_many - verified in test_rename_category_propagates.
Duplicate category name returns 400 with Indonesian message 'Kategori sudah ada' - verified.
CSV headers exactly match spec ['Tanggal','Vendor','Kategori','Proyek','Work Order','Jumlah (Rp)','Billable','Catatan'] and amount column is integer - verified.
PDF endpoint returns valid %PDF-1.4 header with ReportLab - verified.
server.py is 765 lines - approaching but under the 700-line split guideline; consider splitting routers by resource (categories/projects/work-orders/expenses/reports) in a future refactor.
Frontend uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from env - good.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all screens mount and render Indonesian UI + Rupiah correctly)

seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed data (TEST_Konsultasi/TEST_KonsultasiRenamed category, TEST_Proyek Alpha project + TEST_WO-001 work order, TEST_Warung Kita expense, TEST_PropVendor expense). All test data deleted at end of run via cascade + explicit deletes. Existing seed data (Proyek Gedung A + WO-001 Instalasi Listrik + 2 expenses) preserved.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_backend.py and uses Pillow to generate a realistic Indonesian receipt JPEG in conftest.py (Warung Sederhana, items Nasi Goreng/Es Teh/Ayam Bakar, total Rp 88.000). AI extraction works via emergentintegrations LlmChat with model 'openai/gpt-5.4'. If EMERGENT_LLM_KEY is revoked, server returns extraction_failed=true which is still an acceptable 200 response - the test asserts 200 + presence of extracted fields regardless. Frontend uses testID attributes throughout; all tabs are reachable via get_by_text (Beranda/Pengeluaran/Laporan/Proyek). Existing sample project id can be resolved by clicking 'Proyek Gedung A' on the Proyek tab.
rca_of_issue: No bugs found. Only two pre-existing non-blocking React-Native-Web deprecation warnings (shadow* props, pointerEvents prop) which were also flagged in iteration_1 - main agent has not yet migrated them, but they are cosmetic only and do not affect functionality.
